third_party_evaluations.summary: Log management, event correlation, reporting, and SOC workflows on FortiAnalyzer.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Log correlation, reporting and SOC workflows with a two-year profile support associate analyst competence; FortiAnalyzer dependence limits evidence of independent cross-platform detection engineering.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Log management, correlation and SOC workflows with two years of experience support an associate FortiAnalyzer analyst. Production relevance helps staffing, while vendor concentration and no recorded practical cap the signal.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded log correlation, reporting and SOC workflows fit a focused two-year analyst role. The evidence does not show practical investigation or wider incident ownership beyond FortiAnalyzer.
